name: Consolidated checking statement, layout A
notes: A bank's own monthly statement for every checking account a customer has, in one PDF: a summary of all of them, then each account's part under its "Account Number", with a summary of its beginning and ending balance.

Each part lists its rows by kind, not by date -- deposits and additions, checks paid, electronic withdrawals, ATM and debit card withdrawals, fees -- each under its heading and printed without a sign; the heading gives the direction. Checks paid start with the check's number, and the date paid is the last date on the row. After the rows, a table of the balance at the end of each day with activity.
The composition engine hides marks in the text around each part ("*start*summary"); they are not on the page and are dropped as noise.

Checked by balances: each day's ending balance follows from the rows of that day, and the rows take the beginning balance to the ending balance. A month with activity on one day only has one daily balance, which checks nothing by itself, and is checked by its totals instead: the beginning balance and the rows come to the ending balance. Of 26 months of three accounts, 76 account-months were checked by balances and 2 by totals, every one to the cent.
The general reader's words read it as they are; this declaration says how it is recognized and that nothing short of its balances will do.
